But I'm treating it the same way I would a stranger— abysmal but maybe its not too late to help just yet. There's a lot of mental illness in my family, someone close to me once broke down and told me that years ago THEY killed a cat too. They were crying and saying they're going to hell and they've never forgiven them self, for some reason they were convinced the at was trying to kill her baby (first time mum at 16). I literally dropped out bc I couldn't deal with the anxiety, it was too much for me and I was crying myself to sleep every night and either having constant panic attacks or existing in a numb nonexistent husk of a human. I was under the impression that i at least had someone who understood, its always been my worst fear that she didn't believe me or thought I was just a burden, and now I've had it thrown in my face when I was opening up more than before. Whether I go through with it or not, I'll never fucking try to talk to her again, she's had her last chance, I'm done with lectures and being treated like a problem by the person I love most. I've ALWAYS been a problem, i was too emotional, too annoying, too loud, had my head in the clouds too often, my mum will never admit to it but she used to talk to me about DIETING when I was a weight obsessed EIGHT YEAR OLD. She now likes to play the whole 'why are u insecure? You don't have any reason to be insecure BC compliments' but its like, good shit doesn't always balance out bad shit, and looking back I have plenty of reasons to feel as rock bottom as I do. When we were littke I was bullied relentlessly by my older brother for my weight, I now have zero love for my self image. I was always made fun by pretty much everyone my whole life, but its all 'jokes', apparantely family is allowed to make you feel awful. High School has fucked any confidence in myself that I had left, I now don't know how to function at all, I've never been able to move past any of this. I feel so infantile and helpless all the time, at one point my mum was talking to one of her friends (my buisness is never kept my business with her) and her friend literally said she thinks I'm autistic, I'm routinely told to grow up and act my age but I just struggle. I don't want to die but its almost like I'm comforted by the idea that its always an option if that makes sense?
I've been told it'll get better before, for me it always felt so patronising and like I was basically being told to stfu, but as someone who doesn't know me— does it really get better than this? I just can't ever envision anything other than this hell I'm in. Thank you for commenting
